day_shape: 76 items dominated by fallout from overnight US strikes on Iran including a claimed wedding-hall hit in Sirik (Iran health ministry: 18 dead, 108 wounded), CENTCOM denial, two Filipino seafarers killed on a Bahri tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, Peru cutting ties with Tehran, and IDF Gaza tunnel and Nabatieh strikes.

threads.label: US strikes on Iran and Sirik wedding claim
threads.summary: Iran's health minister said 18 were killed and 108 wounded in overnight US attacks across several provinces, with Iranian officials and IRIB focusing on a claimed strike on a wedding in Sirik/Kohestak. CENTCOM denied targeting civilians; Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri called the denial a 'flagrant lie', and Bushehr's governor announced controlled ordnance disposal 12–16 September.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident
threads.summary: Saudi shipping firm Bahri said two Filipino seafarers were killed in a security incident aboard its vessel SIDR while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, and Defa Press acknowledged reports of a nearby incident. Iran International noted the incident followed President Pezeshkian's de-escalation messaging to Xi, Putin and Modi.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF said it demolished a 1km tunnel in northern Gaza, taking cumulative demolitions east of the Yellow Line past 26km since the ceasefire, and killed two Hamas operatives including Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi in a Monday strike. Israeli forces also struck Hezbollah infrastructure near Nabatieh after two explosive drones were launched at troops on the Ali Taher Ridge.

threads.label: Iraq PMF ultimatum on US troops
threads.summary: Iraqi Popular Mobilization Forces secretary Sheikh Akram al-Kaabi warned that US soldiers remaining in Iraq after 30 September will not return home safely, amplified across IRIB and Defa Press. A Jerusalem Post analysis said Iranian-backed militias appear reluctant to disarm, and an Iraqi parliament security commission member said US withdrawal is unlikely.

threads.label: Iran leadership defiance messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB reposted a Supreme Leader passage on Muslim unity and Palestine, while SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei, IRGC deputy commander Izadi, Acting Defence Minister Ibn al-Reza, parliament speaker Qalibaf and adviser Makhber all issued statements framing the US strikes as failed and vowing retaliation. Foreign Minister Araghchi met Hamas political bureau member Bassem Naim to reaffirm support for Palestine.

threads.label: US midterm calculus and Iran policy
threads.summary: Reuters, cited by Iran International and the Jerusalem Post, reported that senior White House officials are weighing intensified military action against Iran after the 3 November midterms, with Trump aides pushing to avoid pre-election escalation. The Financial Times reported Russia has secretly assisted Iran in developing supersonic cruise missiles, and NBC reported recent Iranian hacking of US water, telecoms and energy infrastructure.

threads.label: Diplomatic isolation and sanctions gaps
threads.summary: Peru severed diplomatic ties with Iran, citing Hormuz shipping restrictions and obstruction of nuclear inspections, and UN Security Council president Jérôme Bonnafont said Iranians are victims of their authorities' choices. An Iran International investigation found Tehran's shadow banking via UAE and China banks extends well beyond last month's US sanctions, and Canada awarded over $2m in contracts to a former Iranian VP's son under sanctions probe.

events.summary_en: A member of Iraq's parliament defence and security commission called on the Iraqi government to have parliament participate in special committees following the process of withdrawal of the international coalition forces led by America from Iraq.
